Built for useful first value

No new account or education add-on.

  • Use Franklin’s existing free and member paths.
  • Create a packet without uploading a document.
  • Copy, download or print only when you choose.
  • Minor accounts and school-data integrations are not part of this pilot.
1On-device preparationNo prompt or packet is sent to a server.
2No student recordsNames, IDs, grades and accommodation records do not belong here.
3Guidance, not decisionsNo automated grades, placements, discipline or eligibility calls.
4Sources stay visibleChanging facts must be rechecked at the original source.
Choose a useful starting point

One Learning mode, three bounded tools.

Each tool asks only for broad choices and a short topic. Nothing is submitted, and Franklin does not infer whether someone learned, passed or qualifies.

Educator tool

Teacher & tutor planning

Draft an objective, explanation sequence, original practice, checks for understanding, differentiation supports and a bilingual family note.

Tennessee standards are mentioned only when you confirm a current official standards source.

Guided practice

Use a teach → example → hint → check → reflect loop for adult learning or parent- and educator-supervised practice.

Who the first Franklin pilot serves

Adults working with learning—not unsupervised minor accounts.

  • Teachers and education professionals
  • Tutors and tutoring practices
  • Learning and enrichment centers
  • Libraries, museums, nonprofits and community programs
  • Parents or guardians supervising family tools
  • Adult and workforce learners
Verified local discovery

Start with the responsible source.

These official or first-party links help you find school-family resources, state learning supports, adult education, a local college campus, the library and community education. They are starting points—not rankings, referrals, endorsements or proof of fit.

Search Franklin learning listings Open the education pathway

Directory appearance and order are not rankings, referrals or endorsements. Verify services, credentials, availability, accessibility, fees and fit directly.

Provider profile contract

Useful public facts, with evidence.

The Franklin learning-provider schema covers provider type, subjects, broad age bands, format, languages, accessibility facts, schedule summary, service area and source evidence.

  • Every material fact can carry an HTTPS source and review date.
  • Changing schedules, availability, fees and contacts remain marked for recheck.
  • An affiliation claim requires a direct evidence URL.
  • Student-level data is prohibited from the profile.
View the public schema
Membership fit

No education surcharge.

The initial Learning Hub uses Franklin’s existing free path and current Community Membership choices. Learning providers can prepare a profile, review Growth Desk guidance and evaluate membership without a separate education payment system.

See membership choices Education Growth Desk
Minor safety and education boundaries

Learning support without creating a student surveillance system.

The first release deliberately excludes direct minor accounts, persistent minor profiles or chat history, school-system integrations and automated high-impact decisions.

Read Franklin’s privacy guide

Do not enter or upload

  • Student or child names
  • Email, phone, address or student ID
  • Grades, scores or transcripts
  • IEP or 504 records
  • Health, diagnosis or disability details
  • Discipline records
  • Account credentials
  • Copyrighted workbooks or restricted tests
